## HN discussion (0 comments)

(no comments)
{"decision": "push", "reason": "这是一个面向建筑和土地规划从业者的小型垂直工具：输入美国任意地址即可生成包含地块线、等高线、土壤、洪水区和三维体量的场地底图，并导出 AutoCAD、SketchUp 等格式。页面说明清楚、具体，有示例文件，属于有明确场景的实用产品。"}

verdict.reasoning: Every claim in the reason matches the project page: US address input, parcel lines, contours, soils, flood zones and 3D massing, exports for AutoCAD and SketchUp, and an example file. It names concrete features and a target user (architecture and land-planning practitioners), and its framing as a clearly scoped practical tool supports the push decision.
